title: How Donald Trump makes money – level 2
paragraphs: US President Donald Trump made more than 1.4 billion dollars from digital currency projects in 2025. A new official financial report shows that most of his income now comes from these digital assets.

Trump and his sons started a crypto project called World Liberty Financial, which earned nearly 800 million. This money came from selling digital tokens and business shares. Trump also made 635 million from a special digital coin named after him. Since he returned to the White House, his family earned around 2.3 billion from digital money.

A spokesperson said there is no problem with his official work and business. At the same time, Trump’s businesses, like his golf clubs and beautiful resorts, did very well and brought in more than 500 million last year.
